notes: All six snapshots are Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2022-40 captures (one snapshot per page, no live copy in the chunk); sourceUrl is the index lookup address and sourceDate the capture date. UNSW (25 rows): "Recent placement highlights" list with no years; listedYear null. Lines give first position/employer, and for 9 people a later move after "currently", which is kept in note. Program is the school in parentheses; most are outside operations. USF ISDS (51 rows): page titled "Placements" with year headings, so yearMeaning is "placement"; each entry carries a dissertation title, which suggests the year is also the degree year, but the page does not say so. Titles for older cohorts (e.g. "Professor, Virginia Tech" 1997, "Associate Dean and Professor" 1993) look like current rather than initial positions; treat position/destination as whatever the page shows, not as verified first jobs. Raneem Saqr is the only entry labelled "Initial Appointment". Johan Perols (2008) carries the same dissertation title as Carolyn Holton (2008), probably a page error. Three entries (Michael Harris, Kenneth Trimmer, Thomas Scambach) have no placement. Program recorded as "Information Systems Concentration, PhD in Business Administration" (page breadcrumb); degree "PhD" from the page title. Warwick WRAP (74 rows): repository listing of PhD theses for the School of Industrial and Business Studies (the predecessor of Warwick Business School), 1972-1999; names are surname-first exactly as WRAP prints them (including "Olsen, Richard, Ph.D." and "Delgado S., José Victor"). The year is the thesis year in the repository record; recorded as yearMeaning "unstated" since the page does not define it. No placements. Many theses are industrial relations, marketing or accounting rather than operations; a few are OR/OM (e.g. Connard 1992, Corrêa 1992, Hill 1990, Tayler 1990, Ahmad 1989, Taylor 1988, Flitman 1986, Idama 1984, Vasconcelos 1982, Ashford 1981, Bryer 1977, Morris 1972). WSU Carson College Dividend pages (13 + 11 + 16 rows): "YYYY Ph.D. Graduates" magazine pages, so yearMeaning "graduation" and degree "Ph.D."; program is the field as printed (2018 page prints names and fields in capitals, kept as written). Destination is the "Placement" line; position is never given. Thamer Almutairi (2020) has placement "Undetermined" (destination null, see note). Susan He (2020) already held a Ph.D. from Washington University in St. Louis per the page. Operations-relevant rows: Aizezikali 2018; Lizao Zhang 2019 (Operations Management); Almutairi, Edirisinghe, Kazemi, Luo, Lyu, Muszynski 2020 (Operations and Management Science); Shimizu 2019 is Finance and Management Science.
